title: HP LaserJet Enterprise PostScript/XPS Buffer Overflow (CVE-2025-26506)
description: HP LaserJet Pro, Enterprise and Managed printers may be vulnerable to remote code execution and elevation of privilege when processing a PostScript (or XPS) print job. CVSS 9.2 (CVSSv4). Note: advisory references PostScript; the probe also tests via XPS submission path.
author: Andre Henrique (@mrhenrike) | Uniao Geek
